entries.description: Checked the record before filling E5's route slot and found the recommended route already walked for 21 sessions (4315 lines, closure matrix 11/25). No error existed in any artifact — the drafted protocol was simply about to pre-register a fresh attempt at a mature effort. Taste, not correction.

findings.description: The protocol's own E5 framing (fresh open-problem attempt) did not mean what its evidence would have been cited as meaning (continuation of a 21-session effort) — an instance of the MISFORMALIZED class E3 exists to detect, committed by the experiment's own construction and caught by checking the record.
